messages.posts.name: Publications
messages.posts.description: Unified pages, articles, custom types, taxonomies and public search.
messages.posts.title: Title
messages.posts.author: Editorial author
messages.posts.unsavedHelp: Save the working draft before publishing.
messages.posts.publishHelp: Only the saved draft is published. Saving never changes the public version.
messages.posts.firstSave: Save the first draft to enable publication and preview.
messages.posts.adoption: This source is read-only until an explicit operation adopts it. Original content and history are preserved.
messages.posts.network: The operation could not be completed. Your input is preserved.
messages.posts.invalidDocument: Use one valid JSON object containing html, bindings and content.
messages.posts.nativeHelp: The JSON and HTML tabs edit one document. Original native data remains available.
messages.posts.prefix: Custom prefix, without slashes at the ends
messages.posts.routeHelp: Default pages use /slug; articles retain /plugins/blog/article?slug=slug; other types use /posts/type/slug. Custom prefixes are literal paths.
messages.posts.searchHelp: The public search combines text, type, group and tags. Different filters use AND; multiple tags use OR.
messages.posts.historyHelp: Recovery changes the working draft only. Earlier native history remains available through its original route.
messages.posts.noHistory: No unified history exists for this entry yet.
messages.posts.discussionHelp: Discussion settings and moderation retain the existing Blog contract.
messages.posts.error.route: Use a safe literal route with up to three segments.
messages.posts.error.collision: This address or identifier conflicts with existing content, an alias or a reserved/static route.
messages.posts.error.conflict: The site or source changed. Reload before saving.
messages.posts.error.term: Invalid or unavailable group, tag or author.
messages.posts.error.parent: The parent relationship is unavailable, cyclic or too deep.
messages.posts.error.inUse: This type or entry is protected or still in use.
messages.posts.error.managed: This publication is managed in Publications. Use its unified editor.
messages.posts.error.author: Choose an available author profile before publishing an article.
messages.posts.error.date: Choose a valid future UTC instant.
messages.posts.error.projection: Legacy blocks have incompatible binding scopes; preserve the native source and resolve them explicitly before conversion.
messages.posts.activationHelp: Activate Publications in the plugin catalog before editing types. The search path can be configured while inactive.
